author: John Hammond
description:
Cyber deception doesn't have to be complicated.

Imagine an AI-enabled system that can automatically deploy canary tokens throughout your environment, helping improve visibility without adding another long security checklist to manage. 

The goal is simple. Make deception easier to adopt so defenders can spend less time configuring and more time understanding what's happening in their environment.

Watch the full conversation here: https://www.youtube.com/live/hG1imCvG7B8?si=OM2SJ72Mzj5_DKJA
title: Cyber Deception Everywhere
